updatedBy: The release commit that cuts the version, alongside the npm dist-tag pin. `stable` is the version `go get ...@latest` resolves and `prerelease` is the newest `go/v<version>-next.<n>` tag if one is ahead of it, both as recorded by the maintainer who pushed the tag. The Go module proxy has no dist-tags and no unpublish, and nothing in CI queries it, so this file is a governance record rather than a verified one: it says what the release sequence in RELEASING.md was supposed to publish. `npm run check:release-parity` reads it against the npm pin and the two version strings in the tree.
